boxes.reason: D3D on vcr-kmd is supervised-only (V5 6000 experimental kernel driver); the recipe lists the box as applicable, so it needs a supervised session
Win7 32-bit, GTX 1650 on the Standard VGA stub with no 3D driver; UT2003 has only D3DDrv/OpenGLDrv and no software renderer
Win98 P166 + Voodoo 2: below the ~733 MHz CPU floor, no DX8-class device, not installed by the gate

summary: 7 of 7 applicable, launchable boxes (.110 .123 .133 .143 .171 .184 .240) were proven together in one UT2003 DM-Antalus match on the dev-host server. A fresh roster named Fleet110/123/133/143/171/184/240 (7/12), each box sent 433-500 UDP pkts to :7757 in 12 s, and each fresh frame shows the game fullscreen. .124 BLOCKED (D3D on vcr-kmd is supervised-only); .186 and .243 NA. The game was closed gracefully everywhere.
issues: Several boxes (.110 .133 .171 .184) were connected as spectators at the spawn prompt ("Press [Fire] to join the match!"). They were on the server in the match but had not spawned; no input was sent.
All 7 clients share one player id (the library CD key) and the server accepted all of them at once. Note this for UT2003 LAN play.
.124 (V5 6000, vcr-kmd) still needs a supervised UT2003 test.
The lanparty.py kill syntax is "kill UT2003". The task text said "kill --game UT2003", which argparse rejects.
